systems: Swatinem/rust-cache: OS and arch are separate explicit key segments, plus a rustc -vV hash and the lockfile hash
actions/cache official examples: the Cargo recipe keys on runner.os and the lockfile hash only; no example keys on architecture
sccache: content-addressed per compilation unit; arch enters through rustc -vV host and the target in the args hash
crux.verdict: No crux row is owed: adding runner.arch beside runner.os and the Cargo.lock hash matches the purpose-built Rust cache tool and is consistent with sccache keying on arch-sensitive data; the bare actions/cache example is the outlier.
